title: Keep the GPT Images 2.0 × Seedance 2.0 workflow on a single canvas (don’t jump…
content:
Keep the GPT Images 2.0 × Seedance 2.0 workflow on a single canvas (don’t jump between tools) to improve results and iteration speed.

Use a structured pipeline: prompt → image structure → storyboard → video motion → compare → iterate.

For a soda ad, prompt a 15s commercial storyboard and specify macro texture, splash reveal, typography lockup, and a final packshot.

For interior design videos, start from an empty room and generate a furniture/decor guide as a visual playbook with layout, checklist, materials, and styling logic.

For tai chi/ba duan jin videos, structure the output as a sequential visual tutorial including postures, benefits, instructions, and motion cues.
